_about: Candorify follow-up question bank (from Mariz's doc, Oct 18 2026). The code picks questions from the codes on the bill and decides flags; Gemini only rewords/translates. Placeholders: {qty} {description} {date} {minutes} in text; {answer} {billed} {description} {minutes} {date_phrase} in flag_message/letter_text.

questions.title: Nights in a room
questions.text: The bill shows {qty} days in a hospital room. How many nights did you stay?
questions.flag_message: You said {answer} nights, but the bill charges {billed} room days.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges {billed} days of room charges, but I stayed {answer} nights.

questions.title: Nights in intensive care
questions.text: The bill shows {qty} days in intensive care. How many nights were you in the ICU?
questions.flag_message: You said {answer} nights in the ICU, but the bill charges {billed} ICU days.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges {billed} days of intensive care, but I was in the ICU for {answer} nights.

questions.title: Private room
questions.text: The bill charges for a private room. Did you have the room to yourself?
questions.flag_message: You said you shared your room, but the bill charges for a private room.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for a private room, but I shared my room. A shared-room rate may apply.

questions.title: Emergency room visit
questions.text: The bill shows an emergency room visit on {date}. Did you go to the ER that day?
questions.text_no_date: The bill shows an emergency room visit. Did you go to the ER?
questions.flag_message: You said you didn't go to the ER, but the bill shows an emergency room visit{date_phrase}.
questions.letter_text: The bill shows an emergency room visit{date_phrase}, but I did not go to the emergency room.

questions.title: Observation stay
questions.text: The bill shows {qty} hours of observation. Were you kept for observation before being admitted or sent home?
questions.flag_message: You said you weren't kept for observation, but the bill charges {billed} hours of observation.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges {billed} hours of observation, but I was not kept for observation.

questions.title: Ambulance ride
questions.text: The bill shows an ambulance ride. Did you ride in an ambulance?
questions.flag_message: You said you didn't ride in an ambulance, but the bill charges for one.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for an ambulance ride, but I did not ride in an ambulance.

questions.title: Ambulance miles
questions.text: The bill charges {qty} miles of ambulance travel. About how many miles was the trip?
questions.flag_message: You said the trip was about {answer} miles, but the bill charges {billed} miles.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges {billed} miles of ambulance travel, but the trip was about {answer} miles.

questions.title: Supplies received
questions.flag_message: You said you didn't receive {description}, but the bill charges for it.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for {description}, but I did not receive it.

questions.title: Equipment taken home
questions.flag_message: You said you didn't go home with {description}, but the bill charges for it.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for {description}, but I did not go home with it.

questions.title: Medicine given
questions.text: Did you receive {description} while you were there?
questions.flag_message: You said you didn't receive {description}, but the bill charges for it.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for {description}, but I do not believe I received it.

questions.title: Imaging
questions.text: The bill shows {description} {qty} times. How many times did you have it?
questions.flag_message: You said you had {description} {answer} times, but the bill charges {billed}.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for {description} {billed} times, but I had it {answer} times.

questions.title: Procedure
questions.flag_message: You said you didn't have {description}, but the bill charges for it.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for {description}, but I did not have this procedure.

questions.title: Blood draws
questions.text: The bill shows {qty} blood draws. Does that sound right?
questions.flag_message: You said {billed} blood draws seems like too many.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for {billed} blood draws, which is more than I remember having.

questions.title: Blood transfusion
questions.text: The bill shows a blood transfusion. Did you receive blood?
questions.flag_message: You said you didn't receive blood, but the bill charges for a transfusion.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for a blood transfusion, but I did not receive blood.

questions.title: Comfort items
questions.text: The bill charges for {description}. Did you ask for this?
questions.flag_message: You said you didn't ask for {description}, but the bill charges for it.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges for {description}, but I did not ask for it.

questions.title: Therapy time
questions.text: The bill shows {minutes} minutes of {description}. How long did it take?
questions.flag_message: You said {description} took less than the {minutes} minutes billed.
questions.letter_text: The bill charges {minutes} minutes of {description}, but the session was shorter than that.
